name: Salomonkoita
description: Salomonkoita is an AI-powered full-stack app builder that lets users create complete websites, web apps, SaaS products, and mobile applications in minutes by describing their idea in natural language. It generates full-stack applications including frontend (React/Next.js), backend (FastAPI), database (PostgreSQL), authentication (JWT/OAuth2), AI models, payment integration (Stripe), and one-click deployment. Includes an AI agent system (Claw-like) for 24/7 autonomous agents on messaging platforms, an AI Gateway with 200+ models, RAG knowledge base, sandbox environments, and a complete CRM module with AI-powered lead scoring, deal pipeline, analytics dashboard, and smart analytics.
